Mapayapa at maayos ang unang araw ng Iglesia ni Cristo transparency rally sa  Quirino Grandstand sa Maynila.

Walang naitalang anumang aberya o insidente sa unang araw ng pagtitipon, maging sa rally na ginanap sa EDSA People Power Monument sa Quezon City,  base sa pagsubaybay sa mga kaganapan nina MMDA Chairman Atty. Don Artes kasama sina Deputy Chairman Frisco San Juan Jr., General Manager Procopio Lipana, at AGM for Operations Asec. David Angelo Vargas sa MMDA Emergency Operations Center (EOC). 

Nananatiling alerto at nakabantay ang MMDA EOC. Magpapatuloy ang pagmo-monitor upang matiyak ang kaayusan at kaligtasan ng lahat ng nasa lugar hanggang sa Martes, Nobyembre 18.

Katuwang ng MMDA sa monitoring ang mga kinatawan mula sa Department of Transportation - Special Action and Intelligence Committee for Transportation (DOTr-SAICT), Philippine Coast Guard, Bureau of Fire Protection, Philippine National Police, at National Capital Region Command (NCRCOM) ng Armed Forces of the Philippines. #mmda

data.text:
Pi Network Is Powering a Massive Web2-to-Web3 Shift — And Its Odds of Success Look Remarkably High

For years, the internet we lived in—Web2—functioned like a beautifully engineered but tightly locked fortress. Tech giants offered sleek, free-to-use digital services, yet the true cost was hidden in plain sight: data monopolies, privacy leak scandals, regional blocks, and algorithmic gatekeeping. Users were the fuel, not the beneficiaries, and only a handful of corporations captured the value.

Web3 emerged as the promised revolution to upend that imbalance. Built on decentralization, verifiable ownership, and open participation, Web3 aims to return control to the people. But while the vision is compelling, mainstream adoption has been painfully slow—mostly due to complexity, unfamiliar UX, and substantial entry barriers.

Today, Pi Network is rapidly shifting that dynamic, fusing the familiarity of Web2 with the freedom of Web3. And the probability of its success is not just good—it’s unusually high.

Web2: Comfort at the Cost of Control

Web2’s greatest strength has always been convenience. With a cheap smartphone, anyone can access infinite content, socialize globally, shop, game, or learn a skill.

But its weaknesses are built into the model itself:

Centralized platforms own and control data.

Privacy is routinely compromised for targeted advertising.

Access to information depends on political or corporate restrictions.

Users are passive consumers; value flows to shareholders—not communities.

As countries block apps, algorithms throttle content, and governments demand tighter digital oversight, Web2’s limitations are increasingly impossible to ignore.

Web3: A More Empowering Internet—Still Waiting for Its Breakthrough

Web3 flips the script:

Users own their digital assets.

Smart contracts replace corporate policies.

Value distribution becomes community-based.

Trust is established by code, not corporations.

But even with massive hype, Web3 remained an elite playground—high fees, hard wallets, confusing interfaces, and unfamiliar concepts scared the majority away. The technology was powerful, but not yet accessible.

Enter Pi Network: A Bridge Built for the Real World

Pi Network’s ambition is surprisingly down-to-earth:
give anyone, anywhere in the world, instant access to Web3—using nothing more than their phone.

By reinventing mining as a mobile-friendly, energy-efficient mechanic (tap once a day, earn Pi), the network lowered the barrier to zero. This “everyone belongs” approach sparked viral global adoption, growing into a community of tens of millions across 190+ countries.

Imagine a street vendor in Nairobi or a student in Manila building digital assets without specialized hardware. That’s not just technological innovation—it’s socio-economic uplift.

Compliance and Security: Pi Network’s Differentiating Edge

While many blockchain projects embraced anonymity, Pi Network chose a different path:
strict KYC verification for every user.

This regulatory-friendly approach:

reduces fraud and bot attacks,

positions Pi for real-world financial integration,

increases trust across the ecosystem.

Pi essentially blends the security and accountability of Web2 with the decentralized structure of Web3—without repeating Web2’s privacy pitfalls.

Decentralized Governance for Ordinary People

Pi’s node system is equally notable. Anyone can run a node on an idle computer to help secure the network and earn rewards. It’s decentralized governance built for everyday people, not just crypto professionals.

Recent updates have increased node rewards, improved stability, and strengthened the system ahead of anticipated token unlock events. Despite expectations of short-term volatility, many analysts argue this sets the stage for long-term price momentum and fundamental resilience.

The Pi App Studio: Web3 Development Goes Mainstream

Perhaps Pi’s most media-worthy breakthrough is Pi App Studio, an AI-powered toolkit that lets anyone build Web3 apps by describing them in plain language.

No coding. No blockchain expertise.
Just an idea.
